summary: Background brrClean voice streaming and phone-microphone priority after signed v1.0.212. New source requires exact-SHA debug/full Android CI and original-signed Obtainium before release.

changes.title: brrClean default and private streaming dictation
changes.detail: Default the already-installed, offline native GTCRN cleaner on new keyboards while retaining saved explicit OFF or Android choices. Prefer Android's built-in phone microphone even when earbuds connect, and fail safely on confirmed silenced/misrouted capture; dedicated earbuds testing remains in BR Brain. Feed 5–6-second PCM16 segments with 320-ms overlap into isolated native cleaning and sequential background Parakeet 110M recognition WHILE the microphone is recording, instead of waiting until a two-minute capture ends. Join recognized pieces once, protect editor and cursor ownership, wipe canceled audio, retain original PCM fallback for any native error, and show actual chunk latency, backlog and phone input route in BR Brain. No new ASR model, runtime download, network permission, simultaneous dual-mic claims or raw audio logging. Oppo acoustic accuracy and one-to-two-second final response remain owner test targets, not proven guarantees.
